ministry_date_order.name: ministry_date_order
ministry_date_order.value: "ministries"."active_to" IS NULL OR "ministries"."active_from" IS NULL OR "ministries"."active_to" >= "ministries"."active_from"

attendance_write.name: attendance_write
attendance_write.withCheck: (current_setting('np.role',true) IN ('staff','leadership','admin') AND "attendance_revisions"."created_by"::text = current_setting('np.user_id',true)) OR (current_setting('np.role',true)='admin' AND "attendance_revisions"."created_by" IS NULL AND "attendance_revisions"."source"='workbook' AND "attendance_revisions"."review_method"='workbook_authoritative')

attendance_count_state.name: attendance_count_state
attendance_count_state.value: ("attendance_revisions"."status"='recorded' AND "attendance_revisions"."count" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_revisions"."count">=0) OR ("attendance_revisions"."status"='unrecorded' AND "attendance_revisions"."count" IS NULL)

workbook_authority_origin.name: workbook_authority_origin
workbook_authority_origin.value: ("workbook_source_authorities"."origin"='owner_instruction' AND "workbook_source_authorities"."authorized_by" IS NULL) OR ("workbook_source_authorities"."origin"='authenticated_admin' AND "workbook_source_authorities"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)
